_comment: Vendor is chosen at random for every new agent. Tier picks the model. Prices are copilot-api units per 1M tokens (input/output). Not used on purpose: gpt-6-astra (1000/5000), gpt-5.6-sol-fast (800/4000), gpt-5.6-sol (400/2000).

context._comment: The watcher compacts an idle agent once its context passes compact_at_tokens or compact_at_fraction of its window (whichever is lower). After max_compactions, a lead is flagged for a handoff refresh and a chief of staff is reset and re-briefed from its state files.

limits._comment: Animals may start animals. depth: lead farmer 0, farmer 1, its animals 2, and so on.

permissions._comment: How much freedom agents get. 'open' lets farmers, horses and lead farmers do real work (cloud test environments, builds, kubectl) without sandbox or approval prompts; deny rules (merges, force pushes, protected branches, setup edits) still apply to Claude agents. Dogs and geese stay read-only. Set mode to 'guarded' for the old sandboxed behavior.
